div.p: A child element of identificationData that allows the encoding of either structured, machine-processable expressions of the dates of the materials being described or of a simple statement of these date(s).

list.label: date or dateRange or dateSet or textualDate

div.p: unitDate is for indicating the date or dates the described materials were created, issued, copyrighted, broadcast, etc. unitDate may include date information in the form of text or numbers, and may consist of a single date, a date range, or a combination of single dates and date ranges.

Use the sub-elements date, dateRange or dateSet to provide a more granular, machine-processable statement for the dates of the materials being described. Alternatively, use the sub-element textualDate to capture a temporal statement that cannot easily be expressed in a standardised or structured way.
Use unitDateType to indicate if unitDate represents inclusive dates or bulk (predominant) dates.

div.egXML: <unitDate unitDateType="bulk"> <dateSet> <date standardDate="1832">1832</date> <dateRange> <fromDate standardDate="1848">1848</fromDate> <toDate standardDate="1871">1871</toDate> </dateRange> <date standardDate="1888">1888</date> <date standardDate="1918">1918</date> </dateSet> </unitDate>
<unitDate> <date notBefore="1532-03-30">April 1532</date> <textualDate>Anno Domini millesimo quingentesimo trissesimo secundo post festum Paschatis</textualDate> </unitDate>
